newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair flights to post weaker '96 result.
newsitem.headline: Swissair flights to post weaker '96 result.

text.p: Swissair AG said the results of its flight operations deteriorated in 1996 due to the continued erosion of fares and the significant rise in fuel costs.

"Continued fare erosion and significantly higher fuel costs wil counter the airline's favourable traffic results and ongoing cost-cutting programmes. For 1996 the financial contribution from scheduled services may not equal that of 1995," Swissair said.
Swissair does not publish results of its flight operations, but it is widely believed it lost slightly more than 200 million Swiss francs in 1995.

Swissair also said that in the future it would publish traffic figures and some financial results every quarter. Currently, Swissair publishes traffic figures monthly, but only financial results on a six-month basis.
Swissair is also adopting International Accounting Standards (IAS) for the annual 1996 results.
A spokesman said it was not quite clear which results would be published, but it would not be a full quarterly reporting.
Swissair also said it would report 1996 financial results on April 4.
